title: SOCIOKAIROS EDU – Research Suite for Moodle (Merged Version 2026)
description: SCORM/LTI plugin of the SOCIOKAIROS project for Moodle. It integrates a deterministic heuristic engine for sociological problem formulation and variable operationalization into SCORM 1.2/2004 learning objects, with pedagogical input validation, worldwide geolocation of data sources, methodological alerts, and an SVG problem visualization.
